messages:
claire: heads-up: publish pipeline failed after typegen regen from the new openapi spec. tiny overload reorder caused sample-app smoke to blow up.

dan: can you drop the stack?

claire:
```
TypeError: client.updateProfile is not a function
 at app/dist/server.js:77:14
```

claire: regendiff is small: generated client changed param order for updateProfile (profile, opts -> opts, profile). typings changed so our semver detector flagged a minor and release-bot opened a changelog PR.

olivia: this is the UX we wanted to avoid. nondeterministic generator ordering shouldn't force semver churn.

dan: agree. immediate plan: revert the regen, land a small patch in the generator to stabilize overload ordering, and re-run the publish smoke.

merge-bot: changelog PR #1600 created (level: minor) by automated semver. To adjust, use `/merge-bot adjust-level PR#1600 patch`.

claire: also saw flaky auth/retry tests in the same job that made debugging noisy. can we add a deterministic retry harness so CI failures are clearer?

pat: i can add a harness that simulates two transient 429s then 200, and mark the test as flaky-guard so it doesn't block unrelated pipelines.

olivia: for the semver flow, let's change order: when files under `generated/` change, run sample-app publish-smoke first; only after it passes do we run the semver heuristics that create changelogs. prevents false minors.

dan: filing pipeline ticket now. also we should update the semver heuristics doc to ignore pure parameter-order-only diffs for JS clients, since overload resolution varies.

claire: i've opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/334 (revert-autotypegen). CI queued.

ci-bot: build 2185000000.1 started (revert-autotypegen).

ci-bot: build 2185000000.1 passed  smoke publish succeeded.

claire: merged revert, adjusted changelog to patch. release-bot updated entry. :white_check_mark: 

pat: created auth/retry harness PR and added flaky-guard marker.

olivia: follow-ups: (1) pipeline: pre-semer smoke gate for `generated/` changes; (2) generator: prefer stable overload ordering; (3) semver heuristics doc: add rule to avoid ordering-only minors for JS; (4) add a sample-app test that validates SDK parity after regen.

dan: i'll own the pipeline ticket. olivia, can you file the generator bug with a minimal repro?

olivia: on it. thanks all.
